subject: Discovery follow-up: SSO checklist + technical deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@cardiosense.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: SSO checklist + technical deep-dive scheduling

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the technical deep-dive scoped and scheduled: 

Recap (2 mins)
- Primary goal: validate integration pattern (SSO, API keys, and streaming throughput) and confirm latency/cost targets for a 10k monthly active users pilot.
- Key constraints: CardioSense uses SSO via Okta; procurement needs a basic SOC2 data-flow diagram before POC sign-off.

Proposed next steps
1) SSO checklist: can you confirm whether CardioSense requires SP-initiated or IdP-initiated SSO for sandbox accounts? If yes, do you want us to create a temporary test client in your Okta tenant or provide SAML metadata for you to upload?
2) Technical deep-dive: 60-minute engineering session where we’ll cover infra requirements, sample token flow, and demo custom routing. Suggested windows (Pacific):
   - Tue Nov 9, 10:00–11:00 PT
   - Wed Nov 10, 14:00–15:00 PT
Please indicate which works (or propose alternatives).

3) Attendees: can you confirm the list below so we can lock the calendar and include the correct Redwood engineers?
   CardioSense: Alice Chen (PM), Michael Torres (Platform Eng), procurement@cardiosense.com (procurement)
   Redwood: Sofia (Solutions), Diego (Infra), Rishi (Customer Success)

4) Pre-reads & artifacts: sending a short mutual action plan (MAP) and an ICS placeholder with the time options so you can accept one and we’ll update with the bridge.

Attachment: CardioSense-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

If you confirm the SSO preference and a preferred slot, I’ll send the invite with the Zoom bridge and a short runbook for the session.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: SSO checklist + technical deep-dive scheduling

Thanks, Sofia — helpful recap. A few quick answers: 

- SSO: we need SP-initiated SSO for the sandbox so our QA team can hit the same login flow as production. We can accept SAML metadata from you.
- Preferred slot: Wed Nov 10, 14:00–15:00 PT works best for Platform Eng (Michael) and myself.
- Attendees: add Sarah Lee from QA (sarah.lee@cardiosense.com). Procurement is looped for SOC2 artifacts; they might ask a few follow-ups after the session.

I reviewed the MAP — looks straightforward. Please send the Zoom link and ICS and include a one-paragraph prework for our engineers (SSO info and sample token flow).

— Alice
Alice Chen
Product Manager | CardioSense
alice@cardiosense.com

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: SSO checklist + technical deep-dive scheduling

Great — locking Wed Nov 10, 14:00–15:00 PT. Calendar invite below; please accept and we’ll finalize the runbook in the event notes.

Calendar invite (sent):
- Title: CardioSense — Redwood technical deep-dive (SSO, integration, throughput)
- When: Wed Nov 10, 2026 14:00–15:00 PT
- Guests: Alice Chen; Michael Torres; Sarah Lee; procurement@cardiosense.com; Sofia Ivanova; Diego Fernandez; Rishi Malhotra
- Bridge: Zoom (details below)

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc123
Passcode: 7709
Dial-in (US): +1 669 900 6833

Prework (1-paragraph for engs):
Please collect a sample SAML metadata export from your Okta sandbox (SP metadata or IdP metadata if you prefer). Also include an example signed token (JWT) if you currently use token introspection. We’ll walk through how Redwood can either host a temporary SP or accept your SAML metadata for SP-initiated login. Expect 15–20 minutes of hands-on SSO setup and 20–25 minutes of architecture + streaming demo.

Attachments sent: CardioSense-DeepDive-ICS.ics (calendar placeholder)
Drive link with MAP + runbook: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C-MAP-link

Diego and Rishi — I’ll hand over host privileges to Diego for the demo; Rishi will own follow-up action items and procurement coordination. Diego, can you confirm you’re available to start the session at 14:00 PT and that you have screen-sharing + admin Zoom privileges?

Thanks — Sofia
Attachment: CardioSense-DeepDive-ICS.ics (text/calendar)

Sounds good — confirmed for Nov 10 at 14:00 PT. Please include our security lead (sec-lead@cardiosense.com) on the invite as well; procurement may request our SOC2 contact during or after the session.

Quick ask: can Redwood drop a short diagram in the Drive folder showing where PHI might traverse during the POC? That will speed procurement’s review.

— Michael
